lead: A bound on a wall-clock second can be asserted on both sides without a fixed clock, by waiting for the second, not sleeping.
body: Spin on `Core\Time::now()->toEpochSeconds()` until it changes before signing, so the token is minted at the start of its own second, then loop `while (... < $exp) { Core\Time::sleep(5ms); }` and assert the refusal at `== $exp`, which survives an oversleep a fixed `sleep(1s)` would turn into a wrong number. `tests/conformance/core/jwt-a-token-verifies-for-its-whole-lifetime-and-not-one-second-past-it.nvst` is the shape.
